meta.title: GenAI at work — extraction check
meta.tagline: One exhibit of the paper, every cited cell as printed against the unit it was read into; the cells the extraction missed added.
meta.description: The extraction-check pass of the GenAI-at-work validation as a review template over the pipeline's record: the drawn exhibit as the head, its transcribed cells beneath with the estimate each fed, a verdict on value and mapping per cell, a row for every cell the extraction missed, and a full-review flag for the paper.

stages.label: Cells
stages.help:
What a cited value is mapped to, part by part:
- **Task**: the work the people did, numbered T1, T2 … in this paper (what each one is: under the table).
- **Arms**: the group that worked with the AI, against the reference group it is compared with (people without the AI, or the same people before or after it).
- **Outcome**: what was measured on the work.
- **Subgroup**: the part of the sample the estimate is for; full sample when it is for everyone.
- **Timing**: when the outcome was measured, relative to getting the AI; post-treatment when the paper names no particular time.
